question: Should release-note policy permanently classify `hugin-bot` and `steipete-oai` as automation identities excluded from contributor credit?
rationale: The implementation is a small allowlist-policy change, but the permanent attribution rule and release acceptance belong to the release owner rather than an automated reviewer.

options.title: Confirm permanent exclusions
options.body: Accept the two handles as non-human automation identities and merge after a generated-ledger excerpt verifies the resulting credits.

options.title: Use a broader identity rule
options.body: Replace the two explicit entries only if the release owner identifies a stable, non-overbroad automation classification rule with matching regression coverage.

options.title: Defer the policy change
options.body: Pause this PR if the identities require further attribution-policy discussion before hardcoding exclusions.

recommendation.title: Confirm permanent exclusions
recommendation.body: Accept the two handles as non-human automation identities and merge after a generated-ledger excerpt verifies the resulting credits.
